mode_definitions.exact_shared_section_5:
(creative rules; the tool enforces none of them)
- B = scene count minus 1. FANCY set: BRUSH_WIPE, BURN_LIGHT, DISSOLVE_BLUR, FILM_BURN, FILM_FLASH, GLITCH_TRANSITION, INK_SPREAD, INK_WIPE, IRIS_REVEAL, IRIS_WIPE, LIGHT_LEAK, LIGHT_LEAK_FLASH, PAPER_TEAR, QUICK_PUSH, SLIDE_SHADOW, SMOKE_DISSOLVE, TORN_CENTER_SPLIT, WHIP_PAN, ZOOM_BLUR, ZOOM_THROUGH. SUBTLE set: CROSSFADE, DISSOLVE, FADE_THROUGH_BLACK, FADE_THROUGH_WHITE, GENTLE_DISSOLVE, HARD_CUT, NONE. A non-cut is any boundary whose transition is not HARD_CUT or NONE.
- STANDARD: at least 60 percent of boundaries are HARD_CUT or NONE; non-cuts at most floor(0.40 x B); fancy at most the smaller of floor(B x p) and the generated director budget (p is 0.25 for HIGH_ENERGY, else 0.15); no adjacent fancy; same fancy type at most 2.
- RICH (default for vertical videos under 3 minutes): non-cuts between 55 and 70 percent of B; fancy between ceil(0.20 x B) and floor(0.25 x B); no adjacent fancy; same fancy type at most 3.
- MAX (when the user asks for a transition on every image): every boundary after scene 001 is a non-cut; fancy at most floor(0.35 x B); no adjacent fancy; same fancy type at most 3; short effects (4 to 8 frames) on fast beats.
- All modes: scene 001 is HARD_CUT; every non-cut has a transition_config with type equal to the scene transition and an integer frames value from 4 to 30; both neighbouring scenes need at least 9 frames at 30 fps (18 at 60 fps); no empty motion_config or transition_config objects; no repeated type on consecutive non-cuts.
- The tool classifies a package as STANDARD, RICH, MAX or NONE using exactly these thresholds. If the tool's real FANCY or SUBTLE set differs from the lists above, Codex reports the difference as a SYNC ISSUE.

common.frame_fit: at least nine neighboring frames at 30 fps; eighteen at 60 fps; general formula in transitions section

mode_definitions.generated_director_budget: frequency zero gives zero; otherwise max(1, ceil(B * frequency * factor)); SUBTLE factor 0.45, BALANCED 1, HIGH_ENERGY 1.7

caption_fit.method: Repeated widest tested independent letter; reserve peak 1.1 pop scale and stroke; two lines configured. Spaces and joined/combined graphemes have different widths. Creator auto-shrink can fit longer strings.

motion_config_semantics.zoom_from: Crop zoom at scene start; 1 means the base Fill/Fit crop; 2 means half its dimensions. Overrides the chosen motion path zoom start.
motion_config_semantics.zoom_to: Crop zoom at scene end, interpolated with ease; overrides path zoom end. 1 to 2.
motion_config_semantics.ease: Controls progress of zoom and pan. LINEAR is constant progress; EASE_IN/EASE_OUT/EASE_IN_OUT shape acceleration. TINY_PUNCH_IN with no explicit ease reaches its zoom over the first 35 percent.
motion_config_semantics.focus: Both x and y required, normalized in the full source image. Sets crop center before pan offsets and edge clamping; it does not track an object.
motion_config_semantics.blur: Temporal camera-crop sampling, 0 to 1: zero forces one sample; positive values use max of 2 and Python round of 4 times blur, up to 4 subframe samples. Blends nearby camera positions; does not animate objects.

transition_config_semantics.direction: LEFT/RIGHT use horizontal travel, UP/DOWN vertical travel for QUICK_PUSH, WHIP_PAN and SLIDE_SHADOW. Other effects ignore this field. AUTO resolves during planning; supply an explicit direction for repeatability.
transition_config_semantics.ease: Applies to transition progress before blending/masking, without changing frame count.

look_notes: Intensity scales the treatment. Soften is applied separately before camera movement by blending a quarter-resolution source, with blend capped at 0.35. CLEAN or intensity zero bypasses color grading. Weave requires shake, which V2 product settings disable. Explicit direction.finish is a separate finishing stage. Historical IDs describe an effect, not authentic archival provenance.
